title: Get detailed information for a specific application
summary: Retrieve specific status and metadata information for a single application using its bundle identifier. This is helpful for checking if a specific app is running or getting its current state.

steps.explain: Use `lsappinfo info` followed by the application's bundle identifier to see its details. Replace <BUNDLE_ID> with the actual identifier (e.g., com.apple.calculator).

placeholders.name: BUNDLE_ID
placeholders.description: The bundle identifier of the application, e.g., com.apple.calculator

steps.expect: Detailed information about the specified application will be displayed.
